To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of composite membranes based on Nafion® and polybenzimidazole can be improved by using a Nafion® pre-treatment with diethyl amide, and by increasing the PBI diffusion temperature to 120 °C.
Nafion®-PBI composite membranes were prepared by a diffusion method, and that the presence of PBI increased the performance ratio of Nafion® by up to 2 times compared to Nafoin®.
Nafion®-PBI composites are promising materials for DMFC applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of composite Nafion®/PBI membranes for DMFCs.
the preparation of Nafion®/PBI composite membranes for DMF application.
the synthesis of new materials for use in fuel cell membranes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Nafion®-PBI composite membranes are promising candidates for DMFC applications.
the performance of Nafion® can be improved by the addition of PBI, which can be achieved by diffusion of the PBI polymer.
Nafion® and PBI are not compatible and that the performance of Nafion® cannot be improved by PBI diffusion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Nafion®/PBI membranes have a high potential to improve DMFC performance.
Nafion® and PBI can be mixed in a way that gives an increase in performance ratio, but that the performance is limited by the low conductivity of PBI.
the performance ratio of the composite membranes can be improved by increasing the PBI content in the membranes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of PBI increases the conductivity and reduces the methanol permeability of the Nafion® membrane.
the Nafion®-PBI composite membranes have a higher performance ratio than Nafion® alone and that the performance ratio can be further increased by optimizing the synthesis and diffusion conditions.
Nafion® can be successfully modified with PBI to improve its performance in direct methanol fuel cell applications.
